mentions.name: VW T3 camper restoration
mentions.description: This project restores an old VW T3 camper, using a newly purchased welding machine to cut out and replace rusty body parts with fresh metal.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my old camper (VW T3) and I just bought and tried out my new welding machine to replace some rusty parts with fresh metal.
